test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The sentence below contains errors. Select the option with the correct use of tenses.

Your father will waiting for you when you reach home.

options.text: Your father should waiting for you when you reach home.
Your father will be waiting for you when you reach home.
Your father would waiting for you when you reach home.
Your father waiting for you when you reach home.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. Your father will be waiting for you when you reach home.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The original sentence uses an incorrect form of the future progressive tense** ("will waiting").**
 
• The correct form of the future progressive tense is **"will be waiting."**
 
• The other options (should waiting, would waiting, waiting) are not grammatically correct and do not fit the context of the sentence.

Correct sentence: *Your father will be waiting for you when you reach home*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Future Progressive Tense:**

 
 
• **Usage:** The future progressive tense is used to describe an action that will be ongoing at a specific point in the future.
 
• **Form:** Subject + will be + present participle (verb + -ing).
 
• **Example:** She will be studying when you arrive.
